chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Jamīl ibn Darrāj, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, that he said:
Regarding the drinker of wine: if he drinks, he is flogged; if he returns, he is flogged; if he returns again, he is killed on the third occasion.

key_terms.ضُرِبَ: he was flogged or struck as punishment
key_terms.عَادَ: he repeated the act or returned to it

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling in Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām for a person who repeatedly drinks wine?
ai.summary: This hadith states the legal punishment for one who drinks wine repeatedly. It presents a graduated penal ruling in which punishment is repeated upon recurrence, culminating in execution on the third offense.
